## Goal

The cli tests live in tiers: `bun test` stops running cli harness tests; `bun run test:integration` (packages/*/test/integration/) and `bun run test:e2e` (test/e2e/) run them in parallel with a 20 s timeout. Shared helpers in test/support/, golden harvests from the new places.

## Progress

- Configs: root bunfig ignores `**/integration/**`, `test/e2e/**`; `bunfig.integration.toml` (root `packages`, ignores package test roots' own files and every subfolder but `integration/`, so store/adapters folders not yet in a tier stay out) and `bunfig.e2e.toml` (root `test/e2e`). Scripts `bun test --config=<file> --parallel --timeout=20000`. Bun 1.3.13 facts found: `-c file` (space) is read as a test filter, only `--config=file` works; bunfig `[test] timeout` is ignored, so the 20 s is on the command; a CLI `--path-ignore-patterns` replaces the bunfig ones, so `test:fast` now also ignores `**/integration/**` and `test/e2e/**` (still the workflow check until slice 06; `test:cli` is untouched and now runs only cli unit).
- Moves (all `git mv`): harness, fake-herdr, transcript, observe-snapshot, golden-harvest, repo-root → test/support/. e2e (D4): e2e.test → test/e2e/slice-workflow.test.ts, base-sync, recovery, auto-recovery, observe-snapshots, team, plus pinned-outputs (it imports the transcript/snapshot helpers, B16). Transcripts and snapshots → test/e2e/{transcripts,observe-snapshots}/ (R100 renames). cli unit (pass under the guard): assets, defects, detect + the pure halves of segment (planWorkspaceMoves) and tidy-herdr (planHerdrTidy); `spot` shared via packages/cli/test/herdr-spot.ts. Everything else → packages/cli/test/integration/, plus the herdr plugin block from repo.test.ts (spawns `sh`, D6).
- B16 found a real case: integration chunked-ticks imported `observeNow` from observe-snapshot.ts. `observeNow` moved to test/support/observe-now.ts (observe-snapshot.ts re-exports it, so the e2e file is unchanged).
- Assertions changed on purpose (PR finding candidates): pinned-outputs' expected folders (test/e2e/…) and its REPO_ROOT depth; housekeeping's plugin-hint repo path depth; the test:fast repo rule now expects the three ignore patterns. The ratchet `.agents/norn` lint now also scans test/support and test/e2e, allowlist paths renamed.

- implement#2 (review#1 rework):
  - Bun 1.3.13 `--parallel` runs several test files one after another in one worker process (checked with a probe), so module state carries across files. Files never run concurrently inside one worker.
  - Found and fixed a parallel-only failure (AC8): status-watch "SIGINT/SIGTERM end it (CP6)" aborted on a 50 ms wall-clock timer, which under tier load fired before the first frame (`frames: 0`; seen in 1 of 3 tier runs). It now aborts from the first frame's log callback, once the loop waits. A missing abort would hang the test into its timeout, so CP6 is still tested.
  - Records F36 (blocking): not reproduced. Tried 10 concurrent records-only runs, records after each of the 36 other integration files in one process (36 pairs), records after all 36 in one process (603 s), and 5 full parallel tier runs, 2 of them with test:e2e at the same time. A temporary git-failure log in store gitSync (since reverted) showed no failed spawn, kill or signal. Read and ruled out: view or local-facts filtering (none), wall-clock in store/view (none on this path), detached processes in this flow (none), un-awaited work after sync (none), the base cache in the per-harness home (no ~/.norn leak), concurrency inside a worker. Cause not found. F36 now logs `baseDiagnostics` (base ref, specs tree, the machine dir's base copies and what baseSpecsRoot returns) if it fails, so a recurrence names which read came back empty.
  - Running integration and e2e at the same time (24 workers on 12 cores): 30 s beforeAll timeouts in story-view and recovery's "renewals due together". This is load from running two tiers together, not a race; each tier alone is green. Slice 06 should run the tiers one after the other (or as separate CI jobs).
  - Minor findings: golden refuses a named file outside the tiers before mkdtemp (exit 1, no temp dir, no throw). B16 resolves relative imports and matches test/support/{transcript,observe-snapshot}.ts by path; it now catches side-effect `import "…"`, `export … from`, and support helpers that pull them in transitively, and ignores other transcript.ts files (fixture covers each). tidy-herdr's local helper renamed to paneHerdr. Left as is: the `{[!i]*,i[!n]*}` glob (B5's selection rule turns red if such a folder appears), AC5 (no automated guard run until slice 07), tier selection emulated with Bun.Glob (an assumption to state in the PR).
  - For the PR: test:fast edit (the CLI ignore replaces the bunfig ones), pinned-outputs as a 7th e2e file, path-depth assertion changes, golden adding 9 pre-existing cases (AC6/B18 to amend or follow up), AGENTS.md/ci.yml stale until slice 06, which must land before the story merges.
  - Final runs: typecheck green, bun test 1103/0, test:integration 372/0 (111 s), test:e2e 72/0 (88 s).
